Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the observed daily maximum air temperature at 2 metres above ground for London (Heathrow/London Weather Centre station or equivalent central London station) reaches or exceeds 17.0 °C on any reading strictly after 2026-10-15T23:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-16T23:00:00Z, as recorded in post-event observational data available by 2026-10-17T07:00:00Z.
- "No": Wins if the observed daily maximum air temperature at 2 metres above ground for London remains strictly below 17.0 °C throughout the entire window strictly after 2026-10-15T23:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-16T23:00:00Z, as recorded in post-event observational data available by 2026-10-17T07:00:00Z.

Clarifications:
- "London" refers to central London, measured at a standard official meteorological station such as Heathrow (EGLL), St. James's Park, or London Weather Centre; all temperatures are in degrees Celsius.
- The daily maximum is the highest recorded hourly (or sub-hourly) temperature reading at the reference station during the window above; a single reading at or above 17.0 °C is sufficient for "Yes" to win.
